templates.title: Asset sheet
templates.description: Complete prompts for character, character-derivative, scene, prop, and product asset sheets.

slots.name: Asset name; empty for derivatives

templates.title: Reference video
templates.description: Complete prompt for a reference-video unit, arranged in three parts: reference-material declarations, unit body, and style with negative constraints.

slots.declarations: First part: subject bindings (<X>@Image N), appearance declarations for the same character, and voice declarations (@Audio N); empty without reference material
slots.body: Second part: unit body, with mentions replaced by subject tokens, dialogue tokens reassembled, and narration tokens discarded
slots.co_present_characters: Distinct characters sharing the frame, counting a base and its derivatives as one; empty if fewer than two
slots.products: Product names whose reference images are sent with the request, deduplicated in first-appearance order; empty without product reference images

templates.title: Composite storyboard grid
templates.description: Prompt for drawing a group of shots into one composite grid using a first/last-frame chain, then splitting the generated panels back into individual shots.

slots.reference_images: Reference-image type declarations, numbered “图N” by the order sent with the request; empty without reference images
slots.grid_aspect_ratio: Aspect ratio of the whole composite image
slots.panel_aspect_ratio: Individual panel aspect ratio, calculated from the whole-image ratio and row/column counts
slots.last_chain_cell: Index of the final frame-chain panel; 0 when there is only an opening panel, omitting transition-frame lines
slots.transitions: Transition panel list (index, row, col, from_id, to_id, action, description)
slots.placeholders: Empty placeholder panel list (index, row, col)

templates.title: Storyboard image
templates.description: Complete storyboard-image prompt combining style, reference-image declarations, and shot imagery.

slots.reference_images: Serialized reference-image type declarations; empty without reference images
slots.structured_body: Serialized Scene and Composition; empty for the plain-text form
slots.text_body: Plain-text body; empty for the structured form

templates.title: Storyboard video
templates.description: Complete storyboard-video prompt combining the video body and negative constraints.

slots.body: Serialized or plain-text video body, including speech declarations derived according to admission rules

templates.title: Ad / short film · reference-video units
templates.description: Produce ad reference-video units in one pass from the brief and asset candidates, each with a reference-syntax body.

slots.project_overview: Project overview, an object with all keys {synopsis, genre, theme}; use null for missing values
slots.aspect_ratio_label: Text label for the aspect ratio
slots.brief: Creative brief; null if not provided
slots.assets: Registered assets, an object {characters, scenes, props}, each a [{name, aliases, appearance}] list (angle brackets neutralized; derivatives written as “base/derivative”)
slots.products: Product-information block (name / brand / description / selling points), rendered by code from product data; null without products
slots.target_duration: Target total duration of the film (seconds)
slots.ad_duration_tier: Approved tier nearest the target total duration (15 / 30 / 60 / 90); ties favor the side nearer 30 seconds; used to resolve allocation-table variants
slots.off_tier_target_duration: Target seconds when the total target is not an approved tier, for proportional-adaptation instructions; null for an exact tier
slots.episode: Episode number; ads are always a single video

slots.brief: Creative brief; null if not provided

templates.title: AI repair of a draft requiring repair
templates.description: Revise a draft using its violation report: edit only affected entries for entry-level violations, or the whole document for episode-level violations. Shared by script-plan drafts and reference-video prompt-authoring drafts.

slots.document: Draft document type and entry-array structure description
slots.root: Key of the entry array in the draft body (scenes / segments / units)
slots.targets: Entries to revise in entry mode, a list of objects with all keys {index, item_json, messages}; null in whole-episode mode
slots.messages: All violation messages in whole-episode mode; null in entry mode
slots.source_text: This episode’s source body; null without source text for reference

slots.target_language: Output language for natural-language string values
slots.project_overview: Project overview, an object with all keys {synopsis, genre, theme, world_setting}; use null for missing values
slots.aspect_ratio_label: Aspect-ratio description (portrait composition / landscape composition / "<ratio> composition"), produced by code from the ratio
slots.assets: Appearance of appearing assets, an object {characters, scenes, props}, each a [{name, appearance}] list (angle brackets neutralized); null if the caller provides no asset block
slots.scenes_content: Rendered finalized script_plan shot content (projected by code, including spoken content and source anchors)

templates.title: Drama script planning
templates.description: Split this episode’s source into structured drama shot content: boundaries, appearing assets, visual descriptions, verbatim spoken content, and source anchors.

slots.target_language: Output language, taken from the project source language
slots.project_overview: Project overview, an object with all keys {synopsis, genre, theme, world_setting}; use null for missing values
slots.assets: Registered assets, an object {characters, scenes, props}, each a [{name, aliases, appearance}] list (angle brackets neutralized; derivatives written as “base/derivative”)
slots.character_names: Referenceable character names; derivatives written as “base/derivative”
slots.durations: Duration tiers in seconds supported by the video model
slots.default_duration: Default seconds per shot; empty if not set
slots.episode_target_duration: Target episode duration in seconds; empty if not set
slots.episode_outline: This episode’s outline (title, story_beats, hook, next_episode_teaser); empty if unplanned
slots.next_episode_outline: Next episode’s outline, same shape as this episode’s; empty if unplanned
slots.instructions: Additional instructions; empty if not provided

templates.title: Episode planning
templates.description: Split the source into episodes with a title, end hook, and end anchor for each; drama also includes story beats and a next-episode teaser.

slots.content_mode: Content-mode axis value (drama / narration), used to resolve named variant fragments
slots.source_kind: Source-kind axis value (novel / screenplay), used to resolve named variant fragments
slots.unit_noun: Reading-unit noun (characters / words), following the source language
slots.target_volume: Target volume per episode, an object with all keys {units, seconds, units_per_second}; seconds and units_per_second are populated only when converted from target episode duration, and the speaking rate is formatted as text; null if not set
slots.max_episodes: Maximum episodes to plan in this batch, derived from the text model’s output limit
slots.context_entries: Last few planned episodes, objects with all keys {episode, title, hook}, with null title when absent; empty list if none
slots.progress: Overall progress, an object with all keys {planned_count, remaining_units, window_units}; supplied only with additional instructions, otherwise null
slots.window_is_final: Whether this window contains the full source’s ending (or the end of the unsplit source range being planned)
slots.followed_by_episode: An already planned episode immediately follows this window’s end (true when planning an unsplit source range and this window includes its ending)
slots.failure: Reasons the previous output failed validation; null on the first round
